# M3-15: Import outcomes and timer

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-15`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-15`
- Depends on: M3-14b (and `import_state` from M3-1c)
- Touches (exclusive while running): cmd/, status/
- Plan refs: STATE M2-acceptance lows, R11a, N2
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
A failing bank import shows up in Slack, and a deploy no longer pushes the next import out by a full `IMPORT_INTERVAL`.

## Scope
- The import job records each outcome in `import_state`.
- The status message gains a line with the last import time and result. A failure shows redacted text; Slack failures stay log-only.
- At start, schedule the first import at `last_attempt_at + IMPORT_INTERVAL` (immediately if overdue), then every interval. With no prior state, keep today's behaviour. The attempt time counts, so a crash loop can't hammer import.
- Add the classifier mode and any `auto` downgrade warning to the status message, if M3-14b left it out.

## Out of scope
- Making import failures affect `/healthz`. Changing `IMPORT_INTERVAL`.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: success and failure are persisted; failure text is redacted.
- [ ] Test: status renders a failed import, and "none yet" with no state.
- [ ] Scheduler tests with the injectable ticker and clock: restart mid-interval fires at the remaining delay; overdue fires promptly; repeated restarts don't import more than once per interval.
- [ ] Test: import disabled does nothing.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `cmd/app.go`: `importJob` records each attempt in `import_state` via `RecordImport` (failure text through `a.redact`; the write uses a 5 s detached ctx so a shutdown-cut POST still counts). A rate-budget skip made no POST and records nothing. `importDelay`/`firstImportDelay` compute the first import as `last_attempt_at + IMPORT_INTERVAL` (clamped to [0, interval]); no state or a read error keeps today's full interval.
  - `cmd/scheduler.go`: `Scheduler.ImportDelay` — a one-shot first-import timer, then the regular `ImportEvery` ticker; zero or less runs the import right after the first sync. Nil keeps the old behaviour.
  - `status/status.go`: `*Import:* on/off` replaced by `*Last import:*` (`disabled` / `none yet` / `<time>, ok` / `<time>, failed: <redacted one-line text> (last ok <time>)`), plus `*Classifier:* <mode>` with `:warning: last run downgraded to <mode>` when a configured `auto` ran as anything else. A failed import or a downgrade makes the state degraded (Slack only; `/healthz` untouched). New `Updater.ImportDone` refreshes the message after each import; Slack failures stay log-only.
  - `cmd/classify.go`: `categorizer.LastMode` (effective mode of the last successful pipeline run, nil-safe); `cmd/status.go` wires it, `CLASSIFY_MODE` and the import hook.
- Acceptance:
  - success/failure persisted, failure redacted → pass: `go test ./cmd -run 'TestImportJob'`
  - status renders failed import and "none yet" → pass: `go test ./status -run 'TestImportOutcome|TestContent|TestClassifierLine'`
  - scheduler: mid-interval restart fires at remaining delay, overdue fires promptly, repeated restarts import once per interval → pass: `go test -race ./cmd -run 'TestScheduler_Import|TestScheduler_Repeated|TestFirstImportDelay|TestImportDelay_FromStore'`
  - import disabled does nothing → pass: `TestScheduler_ImportDisabledNeverRuns`, `TestScheduler_ImportDisabledIgnoresDelay`, `TestNewScheduler_ImportDisabledHasNoImport`, status `*Last import:* disabled`
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → pass
- Deviations from brief: a rate-budget-skipped import tick is not recorded (no POST happened, and recording it as "ok" would be false). Failed import and auto downgrade turn the Slack state yellow (degraded); say if they should stay informational only.
- Follow-ups for backlog: none
- Docs follow-ups: CLAUDE.md `cmd/` paragraph: the first import after a start comes at `last_attempt_at + IMPORT_INTERVAL` (immediately if overdue; full interval with no prior attempt), and each attempt is stored in `import_state`. `status/` paragraph: the message also updates after each import and shows the last import's result and the classifier mode/downgrade; a failed import or auto downgrade is "degraded".
